def design(feats) -> Design:
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = tuple(feats.ids); empty = Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    if not p or n < 10 or len(np.unique(y)) < 2 or MAX_DRIVERS < 1: return empty
    labs = list(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[s == l for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum], float).reshape(n, -1)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S]); cache = {}
    def fit(sel=(), prods=()):
        key = (tuple(sorted(sel)), tuple(sorted(prods)))
        if key in cache: return cache[key]
        z = [X[:, j] for j in key[0]] + [X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in key[1]]
        A = np.column_stack([base] + z); b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        b[0] = np.log(y.mean() / (1 - y.mean()))
        for _ in range(40):
            eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = np.maximum(m * (1 - m), 1e-8)
            H = A.T @ (w[:, None] * A) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - m) - 1e-6 * b)
            step *= min(1, 3 / max(np.max(np.abs(step)), 1e-12)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        eta = A @ b; m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(eta, -30, 30)))
        value = float(np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta)))
        cache[key] = (value, m, A); return cache[key]
    R = np.abs(np.nan_to_num(np.atleast_2d(np.corrcoef(X.T)))); sel = []
    for k in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        candidates = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and not any(R[j, s] >= .95 for s in sel)]
        if not candidates: break
        cur = fit(sel)[0]; j = max(candidates, key=lambda c: fit(sel + [c])[0])
        alpha = (.1 if k == 0 else .05 if k == 1 else .01) / p
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2 * (fit(sel + [j])[0] - cur)), 1) > alpha: break
        sel.append(j)
    for _ in range(2):
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [s for s in sel if s != j]
            cand = [c for c in range(p) if c not in rest and R[j, c] >= .6 and not any(R[c, s] >= .95 for s in rest)]
            if cand:
                c = max(cand, key=lambda d: fit(rest + [d])[0])
                if fit(rest + [c])[0] > fit(sel)[0] + 1e-8: sel[sel.index(j)] = c
    def prune(sel, prods=()):
        while sel:
            full = fit(sel, prods)[0]
            gains = [(2 * (full - fit([s for s in sel if s != j], prods)[0]), j) for j in sel]
            gain, j = min(gains)
            if stats.chi2.sf(max(0, gain), 1) <= .05 / p: break
            sel.remove(j)
        return sel
    sel = prune(sel); pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    _, m, A = fit(sel); w = np.maximum(m * (1 - m), 1e-8)
    H = A.T @ (w[:, None] * A) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
    Q = P - A @ np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (w[:, None] * P))
    scores = (Q.T @ (y - m)) ** 2 / (np.sum(w[:, None] * Q ** 2, axis=0) + 1e-12)
    best = None
    for i in np.argsort(-scores)[:20]:
        a, b = pairs[i]; mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
        if len(mains) > MAX_DRIVERS: continue
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(max(0, 2 * (fit(mains, [(a, b)])[0] - fit(mains)[0])), 1)
        if pv < .001 / len(pairs) and (best is None or pv < best[0]): best = (pv, a, b)
    prods = [] if best is None else [(best[1], best[2])]
    mains = sorted(set(sel) | {j for pair in prods for j in pair})
    mains = prune(mains, prods)
    gains = {j: 2 * (fit(mains, prods)[0] - fit([s for s in mains if s != j], prods)[0]) for j in mains}
    if prods:
        a, b = prods[0]; gain = 2 * (fit(sorted(set(mains) | {a, b}), prods)[0] - fit(sorted(set(mains) | {a, b}))[0])
        for j in (a, b): gains[j] = max(gains.get(j, 0), gain)
    drivers = sorted(gains, key=lambda j: (-gains[j], j))[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in mains),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
